description: The rules every systemd unit this runtime ships must satisfy, as cases. They lived inline in the gate script, one `if` at a time, and that is fine until the same rule has to be applied to a unit that is not a file. MEASURED 2026-11-25 on the operator's host, while closing postmortem item A4: the unit that was RUNNING said `Restart=always` with a 4 GB ceiling, while the generator that writes a unit (`buildUserServiceUnit`) said `Restart=on-failure` and carried no ceiling at all. The gate read only files, so it passed — the drift was invisible because the gate was looking somewhere else. The rules are now one owner (`src/infra/audit/systemd-unit-rules.ts`), read by two runners: the gate (over the shipped units AND over the unit the generator would write) and this corpus. {file} = the unit's repo-relative path; the generator's unit is named by the marker `src/infra/runtime/user-service.ts (generated unit)`. {unitName} = the unit's file name. The hard rules (memory ceiling, restart policy, start limit) apply to every long-running service — the corpus exercises them on `ops/memphis.service`, the system-wide unit, whose `MemoryMax=1G` is a documented deployment choice for 2 GB machines and therefore NOT a policy drift. The policy PARITY applies to the local user unit (`scripts/systemd/memphis.service`) and to the unit the generator writes.

cases.name: a unit with nothing to run is refused by systemd
an OnFailure target that does not exist reports the failure into the void
an OnFailure target that is itself a stub reports the failure into the void
a long-running service with no memory ceiling lets the kernel OOM killer act
cases.unit:
[Unit]
Description=MemphisOS Agent Runtime
StartLimitBurst=5
StartLimitIntervalSec=300

[Service]
User=memphis
WorkingDirectory=/opt/memphis
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node dist/index.js
Restart=always

cases.name: a clean exit leaves a Restart=on-failure unit DOWN with nothing in the log
cases.unit:
[Unit]
Description=MemphisOS Agent Runtime
StartLimitBurst=5
StartLimitIntervalSec=300

[Service]
User=memphis
WorkingDirectory=/opt/memphis
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node dist/index.js
Restart=on-failure
MemoryMax=1G

cases.name: the local unit with a different ceiling than the one owner is a drift
cases.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Memphis local runtime
StartLimitBurst=5
StartLimitIntervalSec=300

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node /opt/memphis/dist/index.js
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
RestartPreventExitStatus=101 102 103
MemoryHigh=2G
MemoryMax=1G
OOMPolicy=kill
TimeoutStopSec=45
